notes.title: Box-Pushing Fest Demo - v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hi everyone, we're back with a much more polished demo (v0.6.0) for Box-Pushing Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042167/67413455147c7c62de7ed8409fe8f52bf984b987.png[/img]

Here are some major changes:
[list]
[*] brand new opening animation, explaining Kiko's motivation of collecting apples
[*] brand new shark-theme soundtrack
[*] map layout update (Kiko island & shark island)
[*] new NPCs (the witch and bear friends)
[*] fast travel between (visited) islands
[*] visual updates (whirlpool, shark, level button)
[*] and our favorite, a lovely [b]apple counting[/b] feature
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45042167/110650a67cfb323907e62091001e8b4c47b21b85.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading, and we hope you'll enjoy the updated demo :)

-Chao from PawPaw Games
